title: Pure object chain, depth 8, scalar leaf
rationale: The only structural shape traced as unambiguously lossless on both stacks. It is the good-input arm of the gate: if this ever fails, key encoding, prefix grouping, or setNestedValue has broken, and every DEFECT fixture becomes uninterpretable because a new bug could not be told from a regression in the baseline.
catchesBugClass: Regression in depth handling and in the FlattenedPath encode/decode round trip: an off-by-one in the prefix loop, a change in escapeSegment, or an over-eager array heuristic that starts firing on non-array String leaves.
cannotCatch: Nothing about arrays (it contains none) and nothing about depth truncation (default maxDepth is 50, this document is 8 deep). Also insensitive to field order, because Map.equals and semantic JSON comparison both ignore key order.

predicted.detail: Flattens to the single key l1_l2_l3_l4_l5_l6_l7_l8 = "leaf". No prefix is flagged as an array because the leaf does not start with a bracket; buildHierarchy rebuilds all 8 levels.
